title: about
subtitle: a little bit more about me :)
paragraphs: I study Data and Systems Engineering at the University of Hong Kong and spend most of my time turning operational pain points into software that survives contact with real users: a warehouse system piloted on a factory floor, an insurance database that replaced fourteen years of PDFs, a load planner that solves an integer programme in your browser.
